The '''Event Square''' is a location to the left of the {{Zone|Community Center}} where several events in the [[Hub Island]] are held.

== Overview ==
The '''Event Square''' consists of a fountain in the middle of a plaza connecting the {{Zone|Village}} with a portal to the {{Zone|Dungeon Hub}}. A fountain composed of {{Item|Chiseled Tuff|link=}} and {{Item|Chiseled Tuff Bricks|link=}} can be found in the middle.

During its respective events, the '''Event Square''' changes appearance:

* While the [[Traveling Zoo]] is active, three carts surround the outer perimeter of the '''Event Square'''. {{NPCSprite|Oringo}} stands in front of the middle cart.
* While the [[Spooky Festival]] is active, a giant jack-o'-lantern is placed in the back of the '''Event Square'''. The {{NPCSprite|Fear Mongerer}} stands in front of the giant jack-o'-lantern, behind a desk.
* While the [[Season of Jerry]] is active and {{Zone|Jerry's Workshop}} is active, a giant Christmas tree can be found in the back of the '''Event Square''', planted on top of two huts. Large, wrapped gifts of assorted colors and sizes can be found. {{NPCSprite|Jerry}} stands in the middle of the center hut.
** While the [[New Year Celebration]] is active, the {{NPCSprite|Baker}} stands in the leftmost hut, where cakes can be found.
